children: Sept 17 (Reuters) - Producer prices in Canada rose 1.3% in August from July on higher prices for energy and petroleum products, as well as primary non-ferrous metal products, Statistics Canada said on Thursday.   This followed a downwardly revised 0.3% increase in July. Raw materials prices were up 3.1% in August, and were up 22.8% on the year.
